prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Medium shot. An old woman seen from behind, her face not visible, a shawl over her head, stands in the wide open wooden door in the side of a giant long rectangular wooden crate of rough planks smeared pitch-black, with a flat plank roof and flat square ends, as tall at both ends as in the middle, looking out over the valley and the tents below. Grey morning, wind in her shawl. Sorrowful and resolute. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
